messages:
Maya: Heads up: changelog cutoff for 0.9.0 is Wed Mar 25 17:00 UTC. Quick check: sample packs + quickstarts ready? Need owners to confirm or flag blockers.

release-bot: Scheduled release window: 2026-03-26 02:00-04:00 UTC. Reminder: changelog cutover in 24h.

Jordan: Docs freeze confirmed — I have final PR queued (pr: #4321). Will merge once SDK release is green. Link: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/docs/pulls/4321

Sam: SDK publish is in CI, waiting on `integration-tests/sample-apps` job. PR: #4277. Observed a flaky test on embedding client.

Lina: Sample pack `image-annotator` failing e2e — env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY` missing in CI. I'm fixing, but might slip past cutoff by a few hours.

Frank: I can take the CI env fix. @Lina send the failing job link and I’ll patch the Jenkinsfile.

Lina: thanks — here's job: https://ci.redwood.com/job/2857 — failing command:
```
./scripts/run-e2e.sh sample-apps/image-annotator --region=us-west1
```

Olivia: Quick question: do we need to update dedicated-quickstart for the new model routing flags? If so, that's a docs + sample code change.

Jordan: Yes, dedicated-quickstart needs a flag update. I'll add a small snippet and ping @Sam for SDK arg handling.

Sam: @Jordan noted. If it's just arg rename we can alias in SDK for one release. PR incoming.

Maya: Great. Timeline: if PRs are merged before cutoff, we proceed with changelog. If any owner flags > 0 blockers here in the next 6h, we'll delay changelog and mark as post-cutover patches. Please react :eyes: if you can't meet the cutoff.
